info.title: HRIS Recruiting API
info.description: REST API used by the web UI and Postman. Unsafe methods require `Origin` equal to the app origin, `Content-Type: application/json` and `X-CSRF-Protection: 1`.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase access token of an invited user.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; `code` is a stable error code.

mfaRequired.description: ADMIN/FINANCE grants are withheld until the session is aal2.

delivered.description: False when the email provider refused the message.

roles.description: Roles invited with, assigned, removed or restored.

fields.description: Changed profile fields; values are never exposed.

teamLeadPriorities.description: One row per TEAM_LEAD vertical (priority null = not set); empty without `settings.priorities.manage`.

invitation.description: Latest invite for `INVITED`, `INVITE_EXPIRED` and `REVOKED`; null otherwise.

lastActiveAdmin.description: True when this user is the only active Admin: the ADMIN role cannot be removed (D45).

total.description: Matching users on the first page; null on cursor pages (unchanged filters, no recount).
